said: The Reserve Bank of Australia's responses, recorded by meridian-rba's authors on 2026-11-19: its statistical tables F1 (money market, 4 January 2011 to 19 November 2026), F2 (government bond yields, daily, 20 May 2013 to 11 November 2026), F17 (zero-coupon yields, 3 January 2017 to 30 October 2026) and F11.1 (exchange rates, daily, 3 January 2023 to 19 November 2026), each CSV gzipped. The RBA's own columns are as received, under its terms (https://www.rba.gov.au/copyright/). The third parties' columns are synthetic (the product owner's item 197): F1's BABs/NCDs (ASX's) and OIS (FENICS's) are the RBA's Cash Rate Target plus an invented mean-reverting spread, F11.1's A$1=USD (WM/Reuters') and SDR (the IMF's) an invented mean-reverting walk, all from a seeded generator; each cell keeps its place, its decimals and whether it is empty, and nothing else of the received value. Sample data answers each request from them, and the tests read them; a table recorded again has its third parties' columns replaced the same way before it is committed.
